key_provision_relevant_to_council_financ: Established the integrated local government system underpinning council mandates for health, agriculture and infrastructure service delivery at district level
Reformed the Local Government Equalisation Fund (LGEF) from a capital-restricted grant into a recurrent grant, allowing councils to use it for operating costs including salaries
Enacted alongside CDF increase to K40 million per constituency in 2026; reinforces administrative structures, financial accountability and pension reforms for council employees
